calculator_name: HEART Score for Major Cardiac Events
formula_or_rule: Sum 5 categories, each scored 0/1/2 points (total 0-10): History (slightly suspicious=0, moderately suspicious=1, highly suspicious=2); EKG (normal=0, non-specific repolarization disturbance=1, significant ST deviation=2); Age (<45=0, 45-64=1, >=65=2); Risk factors - HTN, hypercholesterolemia, DM, obesity (BMI>30), smoking, family history of CAD, prior atherosclerotic disease (no risk factors=0, 1-2 risk factors=1, >=3 risk factors OR history of atherosclerotic disease=2); Troponin (<=normal limit=0, 1-3x normal limit=1, >3x normal limit=2).

condition_rules.risk_factors: 0 = 0 pts, 1-2 = 1 pt, >=3 or known atherosclerotic disease = 2 pts
